about_the_game:
“Talent won’t carve numbers into your bank account!”

“To ensure every employee’s potential is fully realized in their account balance, company policy now dictates: no employee shall pay a bride price exceeding 100,000 RMB. Violators will be publicly shamed across the company and severely punished!”

Xu Kuan, CEO of Domi Network and multi-billionaire, barked these orders during the monthly wrap-up meeting.

“My god... it’s the ‘Kuan-Kuan New Deal’!”

Beside me, Xiao Zhang from the programming team let out a tortured groan. “There goes my rating on the matchmaking platforms. It’s gonna tank again.”

I felt the exact same way.

Tell me, is it even possible? Could a corporate drone like me, working at a game company, ever meet a beautiful 2D-loving girl and enjoy a sweet, heart-fluttering romance?

Just as the thought crossed my mind, I instinctively glanced at my female colleague sitting silently in the corner—

Yin Zhaozhao from the Art Department. In private, she’s a "Landmine Girl" who wraps her arms in runed bandages and spends her nights grinding BALOLANT.

A hidden-edition "Landmine" right here at Domi Network? How refreshing!

And just recently, I discovered that my childhood friend Xiuhua—the girl I’ve had a crush on forever—is actually a yandere Landmine Girl herself!

Rumor has it her wardrobe is stuffed with chocolates engraved with my name and notebooks filled with "essays" about me written since we were kids...

Ding!

The choices before you are:

A. You’re a love-starved Landmine, I’m a 9am-9pm*6days corporate slave—let’s just lock ourselves together for eternity!

B. Do everything possible to escape the minefield.

C. Abandon everything, seal your heart away, and follow CEO Xu to the end.

The sweetest Chinese-style "Dating Minefield" story begins now!

At Domi Network, a company notorious for soul-crushing "involution" and constant overtime, I lived the monotonous life of a corporate drone. Everything changed when a sudden accident revealed a shocking secret: three "Jirai-kei" (Landmine) girls were hiding in plain sight right beside me!

YUNA – A sharp and efficient colleague from the Art Department by day, but a total "Landmine Girl" in her private life?

XIUHUA – My childhood friend who hides a closet yandere side beneath her gentle exterior?

AIKA – A struggling underground idol rookie, a pure-hearted girl desperate for recognition!

With over 300,000 words of rich narrative and three emotionally intense "subculture" girls, come experience the most authentic Chinese-style "dating minefield" journey!

YUNA / Real Name: Yin Zhaozhao

CV: Dou Nai (豆奶)

Identity: Senior Artist for Dream Ring: Sevenfold Helix at Domi Network; Xia Zhai’s colleague; highly capable professional.

Likes: Playing Identity VI and BALOLANT.

Profile: By day, she is Yin Zhaozhao—the sharp, elite white-collar professional. In private, she transforms into Yuna, a rebellious "Overt Landmine Girl" obsessed with subcultures. Deep down, she both fears and craves intimacy; she is a rose that grew thorns in toxic soil, yet still yearns for the sunlight.

XIUHUA

CV: Chen Xinyue (陈新玥)

Identity: Xia Zhai’s childhood friend; Print Model.

Likes: Cats and anything cute.

Profile: A "Hidden Landmine Girl." Xia Zhai was her only psychological pillar during her darkest times, leading her to develop an intense, morbid attachment and possessiveness toward him. Her "landmine" doesn't explode directly; instead, she uses passive-aggression and emotional manipulation—feigning weakness, self-blame, and guilt-tripping—to solidify her status and sense of security.

AIKA / Real Name: Lan Qiao

CV: Deng Guo (灯果)

Identity: A struggling rookie underground idol.

Likes: Konjac snacks (Moyu Shuang) and Monster Energy soaked rice.

Profile: A different breed of "Landmine Girl." Her volatility stems from a lack of self-confidence, an extreme thirst for recognition, and the intense jealousy that follows. Pure-hearted, stubborn, and sometimes lacking common sense, her entire logic revolves around the desperate need to "be seen" and "be remembered."

XIA ZHAI

Identity: Operations for Dream Ring: Sevenfold Helix at Domi Network; corporate drone.

Profile: A hardcore ACG fan (Erciyuan) who is kind-hearted and highly empathetic at his core. He harbors an idealized, unrealistic fantasy of his long-time crush and childhood friend, Xiuhua. He serves as the POV character and the central hub that drives all relationship shifts in the story.

Zone (Zhong Xia): Producer / Scenario / Art Supervisor

Brick: Scenario / Main Writer

CuCu: Recording Director (Chinese)

XD: Art Advisor

Anime Slayer: Music Provider

Mumei: Music Provider / Music Supervisor

 

*Many other creators have contributed to this project. A full list of credits will be posted on the store page at a later date.

Thank you all for your support over the past two months; it is your enthusiasm that has driven us to invest more resources into delivering an even better content experience. Many friends have told me that "Landmine Girls" (Jirai-kei) are trending right now, but I am acutely aware that the Chinese Galgame scene doesn't lack "hype"—it lacks high-quality works. Your expectations serve as both a source of encouragement and a healthy pressure for our development team.As of now, we have completed: Script 80% Complete. Voice Acting 60% Recorded. Art & Assets 50% Complete.

The final product will feature full voice acting for all characters (excluding the protagonist). We are on track for a scheduled release in the first half of 2026. Please follow our official accounts and join our community groups to witness this Chinese-style "dating minefield" journey unfold!
